plain.STEM_IMAGE.甲.trait.en: Upright and principled, always growing toward the light
plain.STEM_IMAGE.甲.trait.zh: 正直有原则，总是朝着光生长

plain.STEM_IMAGE.乙.trait.en: Adaptable and persuasive, you find a way around obstacles
plain.STEM_IMAGE.乙.trait.zh: 善于变通和说服，总能绕过障碍找到出路

plain.STEM_IMAGE.丙.trait.en: Warm and open, you want to be seen and to light things up
plain.STEM_IMAGE.丙.trait.zh: 热情坦荡，希望被人看见，也爱照亮身边的事物

plain.STEM_IMAGE.丁.trait.en: Focused and attentive, you glow brightest close up
plain.STEM_IMAGE.丁.trait.zh: 专注细心，近处的光最亮

plain.STEM_IMAGE.戊.trait.en: Solid and dependable, you are hard to move once settled
plain.STEM_IMAGE.戊.trait.zh: 稳重可靠，一旦安顿下来就很难被撼动

plain.STEM_IMAGE.己.trait.en: Patient and nurturing, you make things grow around you
plain.STEM_IMAGE.己.trait.zh: 耐心，爱滋养，让身边的一切慢慢长起来

plain.STEM_IMAGE.庚.trait.en: Direct and decisive, you are built for hard work
plain.STEM_IMAGE.庚.trait.zh: 直接果断，天生能扛重活

plain.STEM_IMAGE.辛.trait.en: Refined and precise, you know your own worth
plain.STEM_IMAGE.辛.trait.zh: 讲究精细，清楚自己的价值

plain.STEM_IMAGE.壬.trait.en: Restless and far-seeing, you carry others along
plain.STEM_IMAGE.壬.trait.zh: 不安于现状，目光长远，会带着身边的人一起往前走

plain.STEM_IMAGE.癸.trait.en: Quiet and perceptive, you work by seeping in
plain.STEM_IMAGE.癸.trait.zh: 安静敏锐，做事靠一点一点渗透

plain.MEDICINE.火.acts.en: sunlight, exercise that lifts your heart rate, and being seen
plain.MEDICINE.火.acts.zh: 晒太阳、做能提高心率的运动，以及被人看见

plain.MEDICINE.水.acts.en: real rest, time near water, travel and letting ideas run
plain.MEDICINE.水.acts.zh: 真正的休息、亲近水边、出行，以及让想法自由流动

plain.MEDICINE.木.acts.en: learning something new, plants and early mornings
plain.MEDICINE.木.acts.zh: 学点新东西、养植物和早起

plain.MEDICINE.土.acts.en: routine, home life and keeping commitments
plain.MEDICINE.土.acts.zh: 规律作息、家庭生活和信守承诺

plain.MEDICINE.金.acts.en: order, precision and finishing what you start
plain.MEDICINE.金.acts.zh: 保持秩序、讲究精确，以及把开了头的事做完

plain.STRENGTH.weak.short.en: run low on your own fuel

plain.STRENGTH.weak.means.en: Your chart has more pressure than support, so you do best when you protect your energy and accept help.
plain.STRENGTH.weak.means.zh: 你的命盘压力多于扶持，所以保护好精力、愿意接受帮助时，状态最好。

plain.STRENGTH.weak.todo.en: Drop one commitment this month and guard your recovery time.
plain.STRENGTH.weak.todo.zh: 这个月放掉一项承诺，留足恢复的时间。

plain.STRENGTH.strong.means.en: Your chart carries load easily. The risk is restlessness from too little challenge, not burnout.
plain.STRENGTH.strong.means.zh: 你的命盘担得起重担。要留意的不是累垮，而是挑战太少带来的躁动。

plain.STRENGTH.strong.todo.en: Take on one real responsibility you have been putting off.
plain.STRENGTH.strong.todo.zh: 接下一件你一直拖着没接的正经责任。

plain.STRENGTH.balanced.means.en: Neither side of your chart dominates, so timing matters more than temperament.
plain.STRENGTH.balanced.means.zh: 命盘里哪一边都没有压过另一边，所以时机比性情更要紧。

plain.STRENGTH.balanced.todo.en: Use the good years below for your big moves.
plain.STRENGTH.balanced.todo.zh: 把下面列出的好年份留给你的大动作。

plain.STRENGTH.follower.short.en: are shaped by one strong force

plain.STRENGTH.follower.head.en: You go with your strongest current
plain.STRENGTH.follower.head.zh: 你顺着最强的那股力量走

plain.STRENGTH.follower.means.en: Your chart gives itself to its dominant element. You thrive by working with it, not against it.
plain.STRENGTH.follower.means.zh: 你的命盘顺从占主导的五行。顺着它发力事半功倍，逆着它会很吃力。

plain.STRENGTH.follower.todo.en: Lean into the element that dominates your chart.
plain.STRENGTH.follower.todo.zh: 顺着命盘里占主导的五行去发力。

plain.PHASE.growth.means.en: Conditions favour building. What you start now tends to take root.
plain.PHASE.growth.means.zh: 条件有利于打基础。此刻开头的事容易扎下根。

plain.PHASE.consolidation.means.en: A decade for building reserves rather than big leaps.
plain.PHASE.consolidation.means.zh: 这十年适合积蓄储备，不宜大步跃进。

plain.PHASE.transition.means.en: Expect a shake-up at home or work. Stay flexible and keep options open.
plain.PHASE.transition.means.zh: 家里或工作上会有一番动荡。保持灵活，给自己多留几条路。

plain.PHASE.corrective.means.en: A decade for care: protect health, money and the relationships that matter.
plain.PHASE.corrective.means.zh: 这十年重在照料：守好健康、钱财和重要的关系。

plain.YEAR.peak.head.en: {y} is one of your strongest years

plain.GROUPS.食傷.gloss.zh: 创造力、敢于发声、享受生活

plain.GROUPS.官殺.gloss.zh: 规矩、期限、压力之下的进取心

plain.GOD_ROLE.比肩.en: Peers and equals stand beside you here.
plain.GOD_ROLE.比肩.zh: 同辈和同伴在这方面与你并肩。

plain.GOD_ROLE.劫財.en: Rivals and bold moves shape this part of life.
plain.GOD_ROLE.劫財.zh: 对手和大胆的行动，影响着人生的这一方面。

plain.GOD_ROLE.食神.en: Ease, enjoyment and natural talent show here.
plain.GOD_ROLE.食神.zh: 从容、享受和天生的才华，在这里显现。

plain.GOD_ROLE.傷官.en: Sharp expression and a will to challenge show here.
plain.GOD_ROLE.傷官.zh: 犀利的表达和敢于挑战的意愿，在这里显现。

plain.GOD_ROLE.正財.en: Steady earning and careful management show here.
plain.GOD_ROLE.正財.zh: 稳定的收入和细致的打理，在这里显现。

plain.GOD_ROLE.偏財.en: Deals, windfalls and generosity show here.
plain.GOD_ROLE.偏財.zh: 买卖往来、意外之财和慷慨，在这里显现。

plain.GOD_ROLE.正官.en: Rules, rank and responsibility shape this part of life.
plain.GOD_ROLE.正官.zh: 规矩、地位和责任，影响着人生的这一方面。

plain.GOD_ROLE.七殺.en: Pressure and hard challenges shape this part of life, and make you decisive.
plain.GOD_ROLE.七殺.zh: 压力和艰难的挑战影响着人生的这一方面，也逼你学会果断。

plain.GOD_ROLE.正印.en: Mentors, learning and protection support you here.
plain.GOD_ROLE.正印.zh: 贵人、学习和庇护，在这方面支持着你。

plain.GOD_ROLE.偏印.en: Unusual knowledge and solitary study support you here.
plain.GOD_ROLE.偏印.zh: 冷门的学问和独自钻研，在这方面支持着你。

plain.POLE.reserved.line.en: You keep your thoughts to yourself until they are ready.
plain.POLE.reserved.line.zh: 你习惯把想法留在心里，想清楚了才说。

plain.POLE.expressive.line.en: You say what you think and show what you make.
plain.POLE.expressive.line.zh: 你想到什么就说什么，做出来的东西也愿意拿给人看。

plain.POLE.deliberate.line.en: You take your time before you act.
plain.POLE.deliberate.line.zh: 你做事不急，先想好再动手。

plain.POLE.decisive.line.en: You act fast, and best under pressure.
plain.POLE.decisive.line.zh: 你出手快，压力越大发挥越好。

plain.POLE.challenges_rules.line.en: You question rules and push against them.
plain.POLE.challenges_rules.line.zh: 你爱质疑规矩，也爱和规矩较劲。

plain.POLE.works_within_structure.line.en: You work well inside rules and rank.
plain.POLE.works_within_structure.line.zh: 在有规矩、分层级的环境里，你做事很稳。

plain.POLE.reflective.line.en: You think deeply and enjoy theory.
plain.POLE.reflective.line.zh: 你想得深，也喜欢琢磨道理。

plain.POLE.contained.line.zh: 你习惯把感受放在心里。

plain.POLE.direct_&_open.line.zh: 你的感受表露得很坦然。

plain.EL_ROOM.木.what.zh: 绿植、木质家具和绿色点缀

plain.EL_ROOM.火.what.en: warm light and a red or orange accent
plain.EL_ROOM.火.what.zh: 暖色灯光，再加一点红色或橙色

plain.EL_ROOM.土.what.en: ceramics, stone and yellow or brown tones
plain.EL_ROOM.土.what.zh: 陶瓷、石材和黄色、棕色调

plain.EL_ROOM.金.what.en: metal frames and white or gold
plain.EL_ROOM.金.what.zh: 金属框架，以及白色或金色

plain.EL_ROOM.水.what.en: glass, a water feature, or blue and black

plain._identity.01.en: are well backed but born out of season
plain._identity.01.zh: 根基不错，但出生时不当令

plain._identity.02.en: are in season but have few roots

plain._identity.04.en: {trait}. You {short}, and what you need most is {med_medicine_need}.

plain._identity.05.en: Day Master {dm} ({dm_stem_el_en}) born in the {p_pillars_month} month; strength {p_strength_verdict} (score {p_strength_score}); medicine {med} ({med_en}).
plain._identity.05.zh: 日主 {dm}（{dm_stem_el_en}），生于 {p_pillars_month}月；强弱：{p_strength_verdict}（得分 {p_strength_score}）；用神：{med}（{med_en}）。

plain._helps.06.zh: 穿着和布置多用 {m_colours}；行事上多 {m_acts}。

plain._year.03.en: No single area is strongly switched on or off.
plain._year.03.zh: 没有哪一方面特别顺，也没有哪一方面特别受阻。

plain._actions.01.en: Bring {fav_en} into the rooms where you spend hours: {fav_medicine_colours}.
plain._actions.01.zh: 把 {fav_en} 带进你待得最久的房间：{fav_medicine_colours}。

plain._actions.02.en: Point your bed head {pl_bed_dir_dir_word}, and face {pl_desk_dir_dir_word} at your desk.
plain._actions.02.zh: 床头朝 {pl_bed_dir_dir_word}，坐在书桌前时面朝 {pl_desk_dir_dir_word}。

plain._balance.01.en: Your own element, and plentiful, but out of season, so it gives less strength than the number suggests.
plain._balance.01.zh: 和你同属一个五行，数量也多，但不当令，所以实际给你的力量比数字显示的要小。

plain._balance.02.en: You are short of the thing that helps you most.
plain._balance.02.zh: 你缺的，正是对你帮助最大的那一样。

plain._balance.03.en: Enough to keep you balanced, but more of it is what helps you most.
plain._balance.03.zh: 够你保持平衡了，不过再多一些，对你的帮助最大。

plain._strength.01.zh: 强弱判断：{p_strength_verdict}，得分 {p_strength_score}，扶持占比 {p_strength_support_rati}%。

plain._flows.01.en: Pressure outweighs support, so pace yourself.
plain._flows.01.zh: 压力大于扶持，凡事要量力而行。

plain._flows.02.en: You already have more than enough {rs_el_en}, so its support adds weight rather than help.
plain._flows.02.zh: 你的 {rs_el_en} 已经绰绰有余，再多的扶持反成负担，帮不上忙。

plain._flows.03.en: Support holds the pressure, so you can take more on.
plain._flows.03.zh: 扶持足以顶住压力，所以你可以多担一些。

plain._flows.04.en: {pr_el_en} presses on you hardest; {rs_el_en} feeds you.
plain._flows.04.zh: {pr_el_en} 给你的压力最大；{rs_el_en} 则滋养你。

plain._flows.05.zh: {pr_el_en} 带来压力（{pr_share}%），{rs_el_en} 带来扶持（{rs_share}%）。{tail}

plain._decades.01.zh: 你现在走的是 {an_a}{w} 的大运。

plain._decades.05.en: Your first luck decade has not begun yet.
plain._decades.05.zh: 你的第一步大运还没有开始。

plain._makeup.01.en: Parts of your life pull hard against each other.
plain._makeup.01.zh: 你生活的几个部分之间，拉扯得很厉害。

plain._makeup.02.en: Some of your pillars clash, so change tends to arrive through friction between home, work and family.
plain._makeup.02.zh: 你的四柱中有几柱相冲，所以变化多半会借着家里、工作和家人之间的摩擦到来。

plain._makeup.03.en: Parts of your life rub quietly against each other.
plain._makeup.03.zh: 你生活的几个部分之间，有些不动声色的摩擦。

plain._makeup.04.en: No open clashes, but small frictions between your pillars wear on you over time. Name them and they lose their grip.
plain._makeup.04.zh: 没有明显的相冲，但四柱之间的小摩擦会慢慢消耗你。把它们说清楚，就不再那么束缚你。

plain._makeup.05.en: Your four pillars sit comfortably together.

plain._makeup.06.en: No strong pulls between the parts of your life, so your energy is not spent on inner conflict.
plain._makeup.06.zh: 生活的各个部分之间没有强烈的拉扯，精力不会耗在内心冲突上。

plain._space.04.en: Where to sleep and where to face.
plain._space.04.zh: 睡的方位和面对的方向。

plain._space.05.en: 八宅 placements for {p_gua} ({p_group}): bed head toward {pl_bed_star} ({pl_bed_dir}), desk facing {pl_desk_star} ({pl_desk_dir}).
plain._space.05.zh: 命卦 {p_gua}（{p_group}）的八宅摆位：床头朝 {pl_bed_star}（{pl_bed_dir}），书桌面朝 {pl_desk_star}（{pl_desk_dir}）。

plain._sides.01.en: This is you, the Day Master, at the centre of the whole chart.
plain._sides.01.zh: 这就是你，日主，位于整张命盘的中心。

plain._sides.03.en: {prefix} you are {img}, at your most yourself.

plain._health.01.zh: 没有哪个脏腑系统被特别提示。

plain._health.02.en: All five elements sit in range. This is a traditional pairing, not medical advice.
plain._health.02.zh: 五行都在正常范围内。这只是传统上的对应，不是医疗建议。

plain._health.05.en: {main_en} runs high in your chart, which traditionally strains the {org_main}; notice {watch}.
plain._health.05.zh: {main_en} 在你的命盘里偏多，传统上会累及 {org_main}；留意 {watch}。

plain._health.06.en: {main_en} runs low in your chart; the {org_main} want support, so notice {watch}.
plain._health.06.zh: {main_en} 在你的命盘里偏少；{org_main} 需要照顾，所以留意 {watch}。

plain._health.07.en: This is a traditional pairing, not medical advice.
plain._health.07.zh: 这只是传统上的对应，不是医疗建议。

plain._health.08.en: Support your {join_x} too; your chart is short of them.
plain._health.08.zh: 也要照顾好 {join_x}，你的命盘里这些偏少。

plain._work.03.zh: 能让你恢复精力的行业：{and_join_fav}。

plain._work.04.en: Treat {and_join_avoid} as harder going, not off limits.
plain._work.04.zh: {and_join_avoid} 走起来会更吃力，但并非禁区。

plain._money.02.zh: 钱要靠持续的努力才会来。

plain._money.03.zh: 钱需要你有意识地一点点积累。

plain._money.04.en: You have a store of wealth that opens in {ANIMAL_br} years ({br}); the next is {nxt}. Those are your years to save and build.
plain._money.04.zh: 你命里有一座财库，在 {ANIMAL_br}年（{br}）开启；下一次是 {nxt}。那几年适合储蓄和积累。

plain._money.05.en: Your wealth store is open, so money moves freely; keep a buffer.
plain._money.05.zh: 你的财库是开着的，钱进出自如；记得留一笔备用金。

plain._money.06.en: There is no fixed wealth store in your chart, so build one on purpose.
plain._money.06.zh: 你的命盘里没有固定的财库，所以要有意识地自己建一个。

plain._love.02.en: Your relationships stay steady when tended.
plain._love.02.zh: 只要用心经营，你的感情关系就会保持稳定。

plain._love.03.zh: 长久的感情需要你用心经营。

plain._love.05.en: You draw people at an even pace
plain._love.05.zh: 你吸引人的节奏比较平稳

plain._love.06.zh: 吸引力是慢慢积累起来的

plain._love.08.en: Keep shared routines and say the quiet things out loud.
plain._love.08.zh: 保持共同的日常，把心里不好开口的话说出来。

plain._months.02.zh: 没有哪个月带着你的用神。

plain._months.03.en: They carry {els}, which {helps_help} you. Keep the other months for steady work.
plain._months.03.zh: 这些月份带有 {els}，对你 {helps_help}。其余的月份用来踏实做事。

plain._days.03.en: No clear good day this month.
plain._days.03.zh: 这个月没有明显的吉日。

plain._days.05.en: Hold off on big decisions on {day_W_date}.

plain._room.01.en: Put {fav_en} on the {side} side of your main room.
plain._room.01.zh: 把 {fav_en} 放在主房间的 {side} 侧。

plain._afflictions.01.en: Leave the {ts_dir_word} and {sp_dir_word} undisturbed this year.
plain._afflictions.01.zh: 今年 {ts_dir_word} 和 {sp_dir_word} 两个方位不要去动。

plain._afflictions.02.en: Do not renovate or dig there, and take the same care on the {and_join_x}.
plain._afflictions.02.zh: 那里不要装修或动土，{and_join_x} 也要同样小心。

plain._afflictions.03.en: Your bed and desk directions still hold; this year only asks you not to build or dig on those sides.
plain._afflictions.03.zh: 你的床头和书桌朝向不变；今年只是请你不要在这几个方位动工或动土。

plain._afflictions.04.en: None of this year's afflictions sits on your four favourable sectors.
plain._afflictions.04.zh: 今年的煞位，没有一个落在你的四个吉方上。

story.GOD_NOUN.食神.zh: 从容自在与天生的才华

story.ROLE.output.en: expression: what you make, say and show
story.ROLE.output.zh: 表达：你创造、说出和展示的东西

story.ROLE.resource.en: support: the people, learning and care that feed you
story.ROLE.resource.zh: 扶持：滋养你的人、学习和关怀

story.ROLE.wealth.en: results: earning and getting things done
story.ROLE.wealth.zh: 成果：赚钱和把事情做成

story.PRIORITY.health.en: So the risk is your body, not your ambitions: protect your health first.
story.PRIORITY.health.zh: 所以要留意的是身体，而不是抱负：先把健康放在前面。

story.PRIORITY.wealth.en: So money is the area to build on purpose, not leave to chance.
story.PRIORITY.wealth.zh: 所以钱财是要有意去经营的领域，不要听其自然。

story.PRIORITY.stability.en: So your relationships are where steady care pays off most.
story.PRIORITY.stability.zh: 所以在感情关系上，持续用心最见回报。

story.PRIORITY.attraction.en: So let people come to you through shared work rather than chasing them.
story.PRIORITY.attraction.zh: 所以让别人在共同做事中走近你，而不是你去追着人跑。

story.PRIORITY.career.en: So give your working life a clear structure before you add more to it.
story.PRIORITY.career.zh: 所以在添更多担子之前，先给工作理出一个清晰的章法。

story.PRIORITY.learning.en: So learn by doing, in short steps, rather than long courses.
story.PRIORITY.learning.zh: 所以要边做边学，一小步一小步来，而不是报长期课程。

story.PRIORITY_BY_VOICE.child.health.en: So protect sleep, food and play first.
story.PRIORITY_BY_VOICE.child.health.zh: 所以先保证睡眠、饮食和玩耍。

story.PRIORITY_BY_VOICE.child.learning.en: So keep learning playful and in short steps.
story.PRIORITY_BY_VOICE.child.learning.zh: 所以让学习保持好玩，一小步一小步来。

story.PRIORITY_BY_VOICE.teen.health.en: So protect sleep and exercise before anything else.
story.PRIORITY_BY_VOICE.teen.health.zh: 所以先保证睡眠和运动，其他的往后放。

story.PRIORITY_BY_VOICE.teen.career.en: So build steady study habits before adding more.
story.PRIORITY_BY_VOICE.teen.career.zh: 所以先养成稳定的学习习惯，再往上加。

story.PRIORITY_BY_VOICE.senior.health.en: So health comes first now: pace yourself and keep regular check-ups.
story.PRIORITY_BY_VOICE.senior.health.zh: 所以现在健康第一：放慢节奏，定期体检。

story.PRIORITY_BY_VOICE.senior.wealth.en: So keep what you have safe rather than chasing more.
story.PRIORITY_BY_VOICE.senior.wealth.zh: 所以守住已有的，不必再去追求更多。

story.PRIORITY_BY_VOICE.senior.stability.en: So time with the people closest to you pays off most.
story.PRIORITY_BY_VOICE.senior.stability.zh: 所以多陪陪最亲近的人，回报最大。

story.ACTS_CHILD.火.en: sunlight, outdoor play and active games
story.ACTS_CHILD.火.zh: 阳光、户外玩耍和活动量大的游戏

story.ACTS_CHILD.水.en: good sleep, swimming and quiet time
story.ACTS_CHILD.水.zh: 睡好觉、游泳和安静的时光

story.ACTS_CHILD.木.en: time outdoors, growing things and trying new skills

bazi_report.ELEMENT_READING.木.0.en: drive and growth in surplus — plans multiply, patience thins, frustration builds in the body. Burn it kinetically: stretching, sport, deadlines with finish lines; prune projects rather than add.
bazi_report.ELEMENT_READING.木.0.zh: 干劲和成长过剩：计划越来越多，耐心越来越少，烦躁会积在身体里。用动起来的方式把它烧掉：拉伸、运动、有截止日期的任务；多修剪项目，少往上加。

bazi_report.ELEMENT_READING.木.1.en: growth impulse under-supplied — starting is the hard part. Borrow structure: morning routines, green surroundings, one live project always on the desk.
bazi_report.ELEMENT_READING.木.1.zh: 成长的冲劲不足：难的是开头。借点框架来撑着：早晨的固定流程、绿色的环境、桌上始终有一个在推进的项目。

bazi_report.ELEMENT_READING.火.0.en: visibility and urgency in surplus — quick warmth, quick burn. Guard sleep, cut evening stimulants, keep one cool hour a day; let others own the spotlight sometimes.
bazi_report.ELEMENT_READING.火.0.zh: 存在感和紧迫感过剩：升温快，烧得也快。守住睡眠，晚上少喝刺激性饮料，每天留一小时降温；偶尔把聚光灯让给别人。

bazi_report.ELEMENT_READING.火.1.en: warmth and confidence under-supplied — energy dips and ideas stay private. Morning sun, cardio, red accents, deliberately social lunches; present work before it feels ready.
bazi_report.ELEMENT_READING.火.1.zh: 热度和自信不足：精力容易低落，想法留在心里。多晒早晨的太阳，做有氧运动，点缀一点红色，刻意安排社交午餐；作品觉得还没准备好，也先拿出来给人看。

bazi_report.ELEMENT_READING.土.0.en: stability in surplus — reliable but heavy: rumination, over-caution, digestion sluggish after worry. Move after meals, decide with deadlines, delegate the double-checking.
bazi_report.ELEMENT_READING.土.0.zh: 稳定过剩：可靠，但偏沉重，容易反复琢磨、过度谨慎，一担心消化就变慢。饭后动一动，设下期限再做决定，把反复核对交给别人。

bazi_report.ELEMENT_READING.土.1.en: grounding under-supplied — routines drift. Fixed mealtimes, one anchoring weekly ritual, finish small things daily.
bazi_report.ELEMENT_READING.土.1.zh: 根基感不足：日常节奏容易飘。固定吃饭时间，每周一个定心的小仪式，每天做完一件小事。

bazi_report.ELEMENT_READING.金.0.en: precision in surplus — high standards that cut inward and outward: rigidity, dry skin/airways. Add softness on purpose: flexibility practice, humid air, forgiving deadlines, music.
bazi_report.ELEMENT_READING.金.0.zh: 精确过剩：标准很高，对内对外都锋利，容易僵硬，皮肤和呼吸道偏干。有意加一点柔软：柔韧练习、湿润的空气、宽松一点的期限、音乐。

bazi_report.ELEMENT_READING.金.1.en: structure under-supplied — edges blur, follow-through leaks. Checklists, decluttered desk, breathing practice, metal-white accents in the work zone.
bazi_report.ELEMENT_READING.金.1.zh: 条理不足：边界模糊，落实容易漏掉。用清单，收拾桌面，练习呼吸，在工作区放些银白色的点缀。

bazi_report.ELEMENT_READING.水.0.en: flow in surplus —深 thinking that can pool into fear or fatigue; keep warm, protect the lower back and kidneys, cap late nights.
bazi_report.ELEMENT_READING.水.0.zh: 流动过剩：思虑太深，容易沉成恐惧或疲惫；注意保暖，护好腰和肾，少熬夜。

bazi_report.ELEMENT_READING.水.1.en: reserves under-supplied — wisdom-on-demand but shallow recovery. Hydration, real rest cycles, swimming or baths, early nights in winter; schedule thinking time, don't steal it from sleep.
bazi_report.ELEMENT_READING.水.1.zh: 储备不足：智慧随叫随到，但恢复很浅。多喝水，好好安排休息节奏，游泳或泡澡，冬天早睡；给思考留出时间，别从睡眠里挤。

bazi_report.STRENGTH_ADVICE.True.en: A weak Day Master is not a weak person — it is a chart that runs on borrowed fuel. Protect energy deliberately: fewer, deeper commitments; recover before the tank empties. Borrow strength where the chart says to — 印 (mentors, study, institutions) and 比劫 (peers, alliances) are structural supports, not crutches. Say no early; this chart pays compound interest on rest.
bazi_report.STRENGTH_ADVICE.True.zh: 日主偏弱不等于人弱，只是这张命盘靠借来的燃料运转。要有意识地保护精力：承诺少一点、深一点，在油箱见底之前就恢复。该借力的地方就借：印（贵人、学习、机构）和比劫（同辈、盟友）是结构上的支撑，不是拐杖。早点说不；休息在这张命盘上是有复利的。

bazi_report.STRENGTH_ADVICE.False.en: A strong Day Master carries load well — the risk is under-loading, not burnout. Seek output channels: responsibility, production, expression. Idle strength turns inward as stubbornness; keep a demanding project running at all times.
bazi_report.STRENGTH_ADVICE.False.zh: 日主偏强，担得起分量，风险是担子太轻，不是累垮。要找到发挥的出口：责任、产出、表达。闲置的力量会转向内部，变成固执；始终让一个有挑战的项目在跑。

bazi_report.CAREER_ADVICE.corp.0.en: Negotiate for scope and expertise, not just title — this chart compounds inside institutions with deep technical ladders.
bazi_report.CAREER_ADVICE.corp.0.zh: 争取更大的职责范围和专业深度，不只是头衔：这张命盘在专业晋升通道很长的机构里，优势会越积越大。

bazi_report.CAREER_ADVICE.corp.1.en: Scratch any venture itch through intrapreneurship: own a new capability inside the structure rather than leaving it.
bazi_report.CAREER_ADVICE.corp.1.zh: 想创业的念头，用内部创业来解：在体系里负责一项新的能力，而不是离开。

bazi_report.CAREER_ADVICE.corp.2.en: Change employers rarely and deliberately, in window years only.
bazi_report.CAREER_ADVICE.corp.2.zh: 尽量少换东家；要换就想清楚，并且只在窗口年换。

bazi_report.CAREER_ADVICE.vent.0.en: Tie pay to performance wherever possible — fixed salary undervalues this chart's opportunity engine.
bazi_report.CAREER_ADVICE.vent.0.zh: 尽量让收入与表现挂钩：固定薪水会埋没这张命盘抓机会的本事。

bazi_report.CAREER_ADVICE.vent.1.en: Keep personal fixed costs low; volatility charts win on staying power, and low burn IS staying power.
bazi_report.CAREER_ADVICE.vent.1.zh: 把个人固定开销压低：波动型命盘靠的是耐力，而低消耗本身就是耐力。

bazi_report.CAREER_ADVICE.vent.2.en: One mentor plus written quarterly goals — the 貴人 channel keeps the deal-chasing pointed.
bazi_report.CAREER_ADVICE.vent.2.zh: 找一位愿意指点你的贵人，再加上写下来的季度目标：贵人这条线能让追逐买卖的劲头不跑偏。

bazi_report.CAREER_ADVICE.ambi.0.en: Sequence it: structured roles first to bank capital, skill and network; option the venture mode for a supportive decade.
bazi_report.CAREER_ADVICE.ambi.0.zh: 分先后：先做有结构的岗位，积累资本、技能和人脉；创业模式留到一个有利的十年再启用。

bazi_report.CAREER_ADVICE.ambi.1.en: In corporate phases, keep one small side asset alive so the switch, if it comes, is a step not a leap.
bazi_report.CAREER_ADVICE.ambi.1.zh: 在上班阶段，保留一个小副业，这样要转的时候，是迈一步，不是跳一大步。

bazi_report.REL_ADVICE.selection.0.en: Slow the funnel: extend the getting-to-know phase past the first impression this chart falls for.
bazi_report.REL_ADVICE.selection.0.zh: 放慢筛选：把相互了解的阶段拉长，别被第一印象带着走；这张命盘最容易栽在第一印象上。

bazi_report.REL_ADVICE.selection.1.en: Weigh stability markers (how they handle stress, money, family) above spark — the spark self-supplies.
bazi_report.REL_ADVICE.selection.1.zh: 稳定的迹象（对方怎么处理压力、金钱和家人）比心动的火花更要紧；火花你自己就能提供。

bazi_report.REL_ADVICE.selection.2.en: Let trusted friends meet candidates early; outside eyes correct this chart's blind spot.
bazi_report.REL_ADVICE.selection.2.zh: 让信得过的朋友早点见见对象；旁人的眼睛能补上这张命盘的盲点。

bazi_report.REL_ADVICE.communication.0.en: The 24-hour rule: write the hard message, sleep, then say it — 傷官 edges dull overnight.
bazi_report.REL_ADVICE.communication.0.zh: 24小时规则：把难开口的话写下来，睡一觉，再说；伤官的锋芒过一夜就钝了。

bazi_report.REL_ADVICE.communication.1.en: Schedule check-ins so issues surface on calm days, not only when they boil.
bazi_report.REL_ADVICE.communication.1.zh: 把沟通固定排进日程，让问题在平静的日子里浮出来，不要等到烧开了才说。

bazi_report.REL_ADVICE.communication.2.en: Have hard conversations on neutral ground (a walk, a drive) — not across the dinner table.
bazi_report.REL_ADVICE.communication.2.zh: 难谈的话放在中性的场合谈（散步、开车），别隔着饭桌。

bazi_report.REL_ADVICE.division.0.en: Write the ownership map: who owns money, schooling, household, and revisit it yearly — parity charts fight over undefined territory, not real differences.
bazi_report.REL_ADVICE.division.0.zh: 写一张分工图：谁管钱、谁管孩子的学业、谁管家务，每年复盘一次；势均力敌的命盘吵的是没划清的地盘，不是真正的分歧。

bazi_report.REL_ADVICE.division.1.en: Avoid working in the same role as a partner; adjacent beats identical.
bazi_report.REL_ADVICE.division.1.zh: 避免和伴侣做同一个角色；相邻比完全一样好。

bazi_report.REL_ADVICE.division.2.en: Score decisions by domain owner, not by who feels stronger that week.
bazi_report.REL_ADVICE.division.2.zh: 决定按各自管辖的领域来定，别看那一周谁感觉更强。

bazi_report.REL_ADVICE.none.0.en: No structural fix needed — use the Windows table: invest in the relationship in window years, and treat caution years as maintenance mode, not verdicts.
bazi_report.REL_ADVICE.none.0.zh: 不需要结构上的修补，看窗口表就够了：窗口年多在感情上投入，谨慎年当作维护期，不当作判决。

bazi_report.WEALTH_ADVICE.steady.0.en: Automate a fixed savings percentage before spending touches it — this chart wins by compounding, not by timing.
bazi_report.WEALTH_ADVICE.steady.0.zh: 花钱之前，先自动存下固定比例：这张命盘靠复利取胜，不靠抓时机。

bazi_report.WEALTH_ADVICE.steady.1.en: Prefer boring instruments (index funds, property, retirement account top-ups); FOMO trades fight the chart's nature.
bazi_report.WEALTH_ADVICE.steady.1.zh: 优先选平淡无奇的工具（指数基金、房产、往退休账户多存一笔）；怕错过而跟风的交易，和这张命盘的性子相冲。

bazi_report.WEALTH_ADVICE.steady.2.en: Review once a quarter, not once a day.
bazi_report.WEALTH_ADVICE.steady.2.zh: 每季度复盘一次，不要每天看。

bazi_report.WEALTH_ADVICE.opportunistic..en: Cap each deal at a fixed share of net worth, decided in advance, and take profits mechanically.
bazi_report.WEALTH_ADVICE.opportunistic..zh: 每笔交易占净资产的比例，事先定好上限；到价就止盈，不凭感觉。

bazi_report.WEALTH_ADVICE.opportunistic..en: Pair with a steady-accumulator for sign-off (see the family delegation map) — the pairing is the remedy.
bazi_report.WEALTH_ADVICE.opportunistic..zh: 找一个稳健积累型的人把关签字（见家庭分工图），搭档本身就是解法。

bazi_report.WEALTH_ADVICE.opportunistic..en: Act in window years, and force a written thesis before any deal in a caution year.
bazi_report.WEALTH_ADVICE.opportunistic..zh: 在窗口年出手；谨慎年做任何交易之前，先逼自己写下交易理由。

bazi_report.WEALTH_ADVICE.competence.0.en: Raise rates and skills, not risk — this chart converts expertise to income better than capital to income.
bazi_report.WEALTH_ADVICE.competence.0.zh: 要提高的是收费标准和技能，不是风险：这张命盘把专业变成收入，比把资本变成收入强。

bazi_report.WEALTH_ADVICE.competence.1.en: Build assets from the skill itself: royalties, tooling, teaching, IP.
bazi_report.WEALTH_ADVICE.competence.1.zh: 用技能本身去建资产：版税、工具、教学、知识产权。

bazi_report.WEALTH_ADVICE.competence.2.en: Let structure hold the money: auto-invest what expertise earns, then ignore it.
bazi_report.WEALTH_ADVICE.competence.2.zh: 让机制来守住钱：把专业挣来的钱自动投出去，然后别再管它。

bazi_report.WEALTH_ADVICE.weak-carry.0.en: Route income out of easy reach on arrival — automatic transfers are the container the chart lacks.
bazi_report.WEALTH_ADVICE.weak-carry.0.zh: 收入一到账就转到不容易取用的地方：自动转账就是这张命盘缺的那个容器。

bazi_report.WEALTH_ADVICE.weak-carry.1.en: Make large financial moves only in window years, with a co-pilot's sign-off.
bazi_report.WEALTH_ADVICE.weak-carry.1.zh: 大额的资金安排只放在窗口年，并请一位信得过的搭档把关签字。

bazi_report.WEALTH_ADVICE.weak-carry.2.en: Grow the container first (health, seniority, routine) — capacity, then exposure.
bazi_report.WEALTH_ADVICE.weak-carry.2.zh: 先把容器做大（健康、资历、日常节奏）：先有承载力，再谈风险敞口。

bazi_report.WINDOWS_ADVICE.0.en: Book the big asks — raises, launches, moves, proposals — into window years; the same effort lands softer ground in a caution year.
bazi_report.WINDOWS_ADVICE.0.zh: 大的请求，比如加薪、上线、搬家、提案，放进窗口年；同样的力气，在谨慎年效果会打折扣。

bazi_report.WINDOWS_ADVICE.1.en: Caution years are for maintenance, consolidation and preparation — they reward finishing, not starting.
bazi_report.WINDOWS_ADVICE.1.zh: 谨慎年适合维护、巩固和准备，奖励的是收尾，不是开头。

bazi_report.WINDOWS_ADVICE.2.en: Recheck this table each 立春 (early Feb): the annual layer rolls forward and next year's weather becomes visible.
bazi_report.WINDOWS_ADVICE.2.zh: 每年立春（2月初）重看一次这张表：流年那一层往前翻，明年的天气就看得见了。

bazi_report.ORGAN_CARE.水.en: kidneys/bladder care: drink water through the day (not one late flood), guard sleep before midnight, keep the lower back warm
bazi_report.ORGAN_CARE.水.zh: 肾和膀胱的养护：一天里分次喝水（别在晚上一次灌下去），午夜前入睡，腰部保暖

bazi_report.ORGAN_CARE.木.en: liver/gallbladder care: limit alcohol, stretch daily, give the eyes screen breaks, walk off frustration the same day
bazi_report.ORGAN_CARE.木.zh: 肝和胆的养护：少喝酒，每天拉伸，让眼睛歇一歇屏幕，当天的烦躁当天走掉

bazi_report.ORGAN_CARE.火.en: heart/circulation care: regular cardio, fixed lights-out, taper caffeine after noon
bazi_report.ORGAN_CARE.火.zh: 心脏和血液循环的养护：规律做有氧，固定熄灯时间，中午以后逐渐减少咖啡因

bazi_report.ORGAN_CARE.土.en: spleen/stomach care: regular mealtimes, chew slowly, a 10-minute walk after dinner, park the worrying at the table's edge
bazi_report.ORGAN_CARE.土.zh: 脾和胃的养护：按时吃饭，细嚼慢咽，晚饭后散步10分钟，把担忧留在饭桌边上

bazi_report.ORGAN_CARE.金.en: lungs/skin care: breathing practice, moisturise, mind air quality (a purifier when the air is bad), sing or swim for lung volume
bazi_report.ORGAN_CARE.金.zh: 肺和皮肤的养护：练习呼吸，做好保湿，留意空气质量（空气差时用净化器），唱歌或游泳来增加肺活量

bazi_report.BOSS_FIT.0.1.en: Under management: demanding, decisive bosses get your best — slow committees and vague briefs frustrate you.
bazi_report.BOSS_FIT.0.1.zh: 被管理时：要求高、决断快的老板能让你发挥最好；慢吞吞的委员会和含糊的任务说明会让你烦躁。

bazi_report.BOSS_FIT.1.1.en: Under management: fair, rule-based managers get your best — arbitrary authority gets quiet resistance.
bazi_report.BOSS_FIT.1.1.zh: 被管理时：公平、按规则办事的上司能让你发挥最好；任意妄为的权威只会换来你无声的抵抗。

bazi_report.BOSS_FIT.2.1.en: Under management: negotiate autonomy and judge-me-by-output arrangements — heavy supervision wastes this chart.
bazi_report.BOSS_FIT.2.1.zh: 被管理时：争取自主权，以及按产出来评价你的安排；管得太紧会浪费这张命盘。

bazi_report.PARTNER_SUPPLY.財.en: someone who spots opportunities and closes deals (財-rich)
bazi_report.PARTNER_SUPPLY.財.zh: 能发现机会、谈成买卖的人（财旺）

bazi_report.PARTNER_SUPPLY.官殺.en: someone who enforces structure, deadlines and discipline (官殺-rich)
bazi_report.PARTNER_SUPPLY.官殺.zh: 能把约束、期限和纪律落实下来的人（官杀旺）

bazi_report.PARTNER_SUPPLY.印.en: someone who researches, documents and keeps institutional memory (印-rich)
bazi_report.PARTNER_SUPPLY.印.zh: 能做研究、写文档、守住机构记忆的人（印旺）

bazi_report.PARTNER_SUPPLY.食傷.en: someone who presents, markets and charms the room (食傷-rich)
bazi_report.PARTNER_SUPPLY.食傷.zh: 能做展示、做推广、在人群里讨人喜欢的人（食伤旺）

bazi_report.PARTNER_SUPPLY.比劫.en: someone who brings manpower, network and shared grind (比劫-rich)
bazi_report.PARTNER_SUPPLY.比劫.zh: 能带来人手、人脉和一起苦干的人（比劫旺）

bazi_report.GOD_HANDLE.正官.en: give clear rules, fair process and visible standards — they honour them
bazi_report.GOD_HANDLE.正官.zh: 给清楚的规则、公平的流程和看得见的标准，他们会遵守

bazi_report.GOD_HANDLE.七殺.en: give autonomy plus hard deadlines; pressure motivates, micromanagement backfires
bazi_report.GOD_HANDLE.七殺.zh: 给自主权，再配上硬期限；压力能激励他们，事无巨细地盯着只会适得其反

bazi_report.GOD_HANDLE.正印.en: teach the why; they absorb through study and trusted mentors
bazi_report.GOD_HANDLE.正印.zh: 把为什么讲清楚；他们靠学习和信得过的贵人来吸收

bazi_report.GOD_HANDLE.偏印.en: let them learn sideways — unusual methods and niche depth are features
bazi_report.GOD_HANDLE.偏印.zh: 让他们换条路去学：不寻常的方法和冷门的深度，都是优点

bazi_report.GOD_HANDLE.比肩.en: respect their independence; ask, don't command; peer framing works
bazi_report.GOD_HANDLE.比肩.zh: 尊重他们的独立；用请求，别用命令；同辈的口吻最管用

bazi_report.GOD_HANDLE.劫財.en: channel competitiveness into team wins; watch impulsive sharing/spending
bazi_report.GOD_HANDLE.劫財.zh: 把好胜心引向团队的胜利；留意冲动的分享和花销

bazi_report.GOD_HANDLE.食神.en: give them room to craft and finish; praise the work, not the speed
bazi_report.GOD_HANDLE.食神.zh: 给他们空间去琢磨、去做完；夸作品，不夸速度

bazi_report.GOD_HANDLE.傷官.en: let them speak and perform; correct in private, never on stage
bazi_report.GOD_HANDLE.傷官.zh: 让他们发言、登台；要纠正就私下说，千万别当众

bazi_report.GOD_HANDLE.正財.en: steady routines and visible savings goals; they compound
bazi_report.GOD_HANDLE.正財.zh: 稳定的日常和看得见的储蓄目标；他们会越积越多

bazi_report.GOD_HANDLE.偏財.en: give opportunity and a budget cap; teach them to finish one deal before the next
bazi_report.GOD_HANDLE.偏財.zh: 给机会，同时给预算上限；教他们先做完一单，再做下一单

bazi_report.dial.01.en: built for STRUCTURED environments — corporate ladders, institutions, expert tracks
bazi_report.dial.01.zh: 适合结构清晰的环境：公司晋升序列、机构、专家路线

bazi_report.dial.02.en: built for HIGH-VOLATILITY work — ventures, deals, performance-paid roles
bazi_report.dial.02.zh: 适合高波动的工作：创业、交易、按业绩付酬的岗位

bazi_report.dial.03.en: AMBIDEXTROUS — can run either mode; pick by season of life
bazi_report.dial.03.zh: 两栖：两种模式都能跑，按人生的阶段来选

bazi_report.relationship_risk.01.en: both 正/偏 spouse stars present — attracts mixed signals
bazi_report.relationship_risk.01.zh: 正、偏配偶星都有：容易收到混杂的信号

bazi_report.relationship_risk.02.en: no spouse star — partners found through activity, not gravity
bazi_report.relationship_risk.02.zh: 没有配偶星：伴侣是在活动中遇到的，不是被吸引来的

bazi_report.relationship_risk.03.en: 桃花 outside the walls — variable attraction
bazi_report.relationship_risk.03.zh: 桃花在墙外：吸引力忽高忽低

bazi_report.relationship_risk.04.en: 傷官 {pct_傷官:.0f}% — sharp expression cuts close partners first
bazi_report.relationship_risk.04.zh: 伤官 {pct_傷官:.0f}%：言辞锋利，最先伤到身边的伴侣

bazi_report.relationship_risk.05.en: day branch clashed by the {join_day_hits} pillar — friction lives in daily contact
bazi_report.relationship_risk.05.zh: 日支被 {join_day_hits} 柱冲到：摩擦出在日常相处里

bazi_report.relationship_risk.06.en: heavy 比劫 — parity struggles: who leads, who yields
bazi_report.relationship_risk.06.zh: 比劫偏重：地位对等的较劲，谁带头，谁让步

bazi_report.relationship_risk.07.en: 七殺 without 正官 — control asserted under stress
bazi_report.relationship_risk.07.zh: 有七杀而无正官：压力下会变得强势，爱控制

bazi_report.relationship_risk.08.en: no dominant structural risk point — pattern risks are situational
bazi_report.relationship_risk.08.zh: 没有突出的结构性风险点：风险来自具体情境

bazi_report.relationship_risk.09.en: partner SELECTION — who is chosen matters more than how it's run
bazi_report.relationship_risk.09.zh: 伴侣的选择：选了谁，比怎么经营更重要

bazi_report.relationship_risk.10.en: COMMUNICATION — the relationship works when the channel does
bazi_report.relationship_risk.10.zh: 沟通：渠道通了，关系才运转得起来

bazi_report.relationship_risk.11.en: ROLE DIVISION — agree who owns what, explicitly
bazi_report.relationship_risk.11.zh: 角色分工：明明白白讲清楚谁管什么

bazi_report.wealth_pattern.01.en: OPPORTUNISTIC 偏財 — lumpy income: deals, ventures, timing plays
bazi_report.wealth_pattern.01.zh: 机会型偏财：收入起伏大，靠买卖、创业和抓时机

bazi_report.wealth_pattern.02.en: STEADY ACCUMULATOR 正財 — salary, savings and compounding beat speculation
bazi_report.wealth_pattern.02.zh: 稳健积累型正财：薪水、储蓄和复利胜过投机

bazi_report.wealth_pattern.03.en: MODEST wealth stars — income follows competence (食傷生財 route): monetise skill, not capital
bazi_report.wealth_pattern.03.zh: 财星偏弱：收入跟着能力走（食伤生财之路），把技能变现，不靠资本

bazi_report.wealth_pattern.04.en: NO wealth star — earn through expertise and let structure hold the money
bazi_report.wealth_pattern.04.zh: 没有财星：靠专业赚钱，让机制来守住钱

bazi_report.wealth_pattern.05.en: the chart is WEAK relative to its wealth element — money that arrives tends to pass through; build the container (health, routine, seniority) before scaling exposure
bazi_report.wealth_pattern.05.zh: 相对于财星所属的五行，命盘偏弱：到手的钱容易流走；先把容器做大（健康、日常节奏、资历），再扩大敞口

bazi_report.wealth_pattern.06.en: the chart can HOLD wealth — favourable periods reward decisive action
bazi_report.wealth_pattern.06.zh: 命盘守得住财：有利的时期，果断行动会有回报

bazi_report.exam_overlay.02.en: 文昌 year — the scholar star itself arrives ✓
bazi_report.exam_overlay.02.zh: 文昌年：主学业的文昌星亲自到了 ✓

bazi_report.exam_overlay.04.zh: 超出10年窗口，请到更近的时候再复查

bazi_report.people_compat.01.en: people whose charts run rich in {join_ys_favourable} energize you; heavy-{join_ys_unfavourable} people are fine in small doses but tiring as daily fixtures

bazi_report.strategy_payload.02.en: keep the balanced baseline: seasonal food, regular sleep, and use recovery years for elective procedures and habit resets.
bazi_report.strategy_payload.02.zh: 保持均衡的基线：吃应季的食物，睡眠规律，在恢复年里安排择期的治疗或手术，并重设习惯。

bazi_report.strategy_payload.03.en: Double the care in trigger years; schedule check-ups into them in advance.
bazi_report.strategy_payload.03.zh: 触发年里加倍小心；提前把体检排进去。

bazi_report.strategy_payload.04.en: Fields carry elements: prefer {join_ys_favourable}-flavoured industries even inside the same job title — the same work in the right field costs less energy.
bazi_report.strategy_payload.04.zh: 行业带着五行：即使职位相同，也优先选五行属 {join_ys_favourable} 的行业；同样的工作放在对的行业里，耗的精力更少。

bazi_report.strategy_payload.05.en: Ideal collaborator: this chart's thinnest resource is {pc_weak_group} — team up with {pc_partner}.
bazi_report.strategy_payload.05.zh: 理想搭档：这张命盘最薄弱的资源是 {pc_weak_group}，不妨和 {pc_partner} 合作。

interpret.KE_META.('金',_'木').en: structure prunes growth — rules and rigidity cut initiative

interpret.ABSENT_COST.木.zh: 主动和新的开始需要刻意用力

interpret.ABSENT_COST.火.en: visibility and self-promotion need deliberate effort
interpret.ABSENT_COST.火.zh: 存在感和自我推介需要刻意用力

interpret.ABSENT_COST.土.en: grounding and routine need deliberate effort
interpret.ABSENT_COST.土.zh: 踏实和规律需要刻意用力

interpret.ABSENT_COST.金.en: structure and follow-through need deliberate effort

interpret.ABSENT_COST.水.en: adaptability and communication need deliberate effort

interpret.PALACE_INFO.0.3.en: ancestry, childhood environment, first impressions on strangers
interpret.PALACE_INFO.0.3.zh: 祖上、童年环境、给陌生人的第一印象

interpret.PALACE_INFO.1.3.en: parents, early adulthood, the career headquarters
interpret.PALACE_INFO.1.3.zh: 父母、青年时期、事业的大本营

interpret.PALACE_INFO.2.3.en: the self (stem) · spouse and domestic life (branch)
interpret.PALACE_INFO.2.3.zh: 自己（天干）· 配偶与家庭生活（地支）

interpret.PALACE_INFO.3.3.en: children, late-life luck, side pursuits, the subconscious
interpret.PALACE_INFO.3.3.zh: 子女、晚年运势、副业爱好、潜意识

interpret._PALACE_TMPL.month.en: The career HQ is {god}-flavoured: {meaning} — the environment your working life grows in
interpret._PALACE_TMPL.month.zh: 事业的大本营带着 {god} 的底色：{meaning}；这是你的职业生涯生长的土壤

interpret._PALACE_TMPL.day.en: You sit on {god}: {meaning} — see the spouse-palace reading (十神/婚戀)
interpret._PALACE_TMPL.day.zh: 你坐 {god}：{meaning}，详见配偶宫的解读（十神/婚恋）

interpret._PALACE_TMPL.hour.en: The fruit palace carries {god}: {meaning} — the flavour of children, students and late-life work
interpret._PALACE_TMPL.hour.zh: 果实宫带 {god}：{meaning}，影响子女、学生和晚年工作的底色

interpret.element_relations.02.en: support, learning, protection — your recharge line
interpret.element_relations.02.zh: 扶持、学习、庇护，是你补充能量的通道

interpret.element_relations.04.en: expression and output — spends your energy
interpret.element_relations.04.zh: 表达和输出，消耗你的能量

interpret.element_relations.06.en: wealth — results the chart can seize and hold
interpret.element_relations.06.zh: 财星：命盘抓得住、留得住的成果

interpret.element_relations.08.zh: 纪律、事业压力、外在约束

interpret.element_relations.09.zh: 自身力量、兄弟姐妹、竞争

interpret.element_relations.10.en: {hi} dominates at {share_hi}% — {hi_element_trait} colours the whole chart, and its excesses are the first faults to watch.
interpret.element_relations.10.zh: {hi} 占 {share_hi}%，是命盘里最旺的一方，{hi_element_trait} 的特质染透整张命盘，它过头的地方是最先要留意的毛病。

interpret.element_relations.11.en: {el} is effectively absent ({s}%) — {el_absent_cost}; the generating chain into {el_sheng_c} also loses its feeder.
interpret.element_relations.11.zh: {el} 几乎缺失（{s}%），{el_absent_cost}；通向 {el_sheng_c} 的相生链也因此少了供给。

interpret.element_relations.13.en: Two strong camps: {a} ({share_a}%) vs {b} ({share_b}%) — {x_ke_meta}; a recurring life theme, manageable once named.
interpret.element_relations.13.zh: 两大阵营对峙：{a}（{share_a}%）对 {b}（{share_b}%），{x_ke_meta}；这是反复出现的人生主题，点明之后就好应对。

interpret.element_relations.14.en: The support line is intact: {r_el} ({r_share}%) 生 {dm_el} — {x_sheng_meta}; help and recovery are structurally available.
interpret.element_relations.14.zh: 扶持线是通的：{r_el}（{r_share}%）生 {dm_el}，{x_sheng_meta}；帮助和恢复在结构上是有的。

interpret.element_relations.15.en: The support line is thin: {r_el} ({r_share}%) barely feeds {dm_el} — recharge does not happen by itself here; build it in deliberately (rest, mentors, study).
interpret.element_relations.15.zh: 扶持线偏细：{r_el}（{r_share}%）很难滋养 {dm_el}，能量不会自己补回来，要主动安排进去（休息、贵人、学习）。

interpret.element_relations.16.en: 五行生剋 cycles applied to this chart's weighted element balance
interpret.element_relations.16.zh: 五行生克的循环，套用在这张命盘加权后的五行比重上

interpret.ten_god_insights.01.en: carries {el} — one of your 用神: a clean engine, using it strengthens the chart
interpret.ten_god_insights.01.zh: 带 {el}，是你的用神之一：这是一台干净的引擎，用它会让命盘更有力

interpret.ten_god_insights.02.en: carries {el} — an UNFAVOURABLE element here: its gifts run on borrowed energy; use it deliberately and budget recovery
interpret.ten_god_insights.02.zh: 带 {el}，对你是忌：它的长处靠透支来的能量运转，要有意识地用，并留出恢复的时间

interpret.ten_god_insights.06.en: formed 已成 (all components 透干)
interpret.ten_god_insights.06.zh: 已成（各组成部分都透干）

interpret.ten_god_insights.08.en: the {dec_gz} decade (ages {dec_ages}) brings the missing component — the pattern activates then
interpret.ten_god_insights.08.zh: {dec_gz} 这步大运（{dec_ages}岁）会补上缺的那一块，格局到那时才被激活

interpret.ten_god_insights.09.zh: 精炼的本事能驯服力量

interpret.ten_god_insights.10.en: the advisor pattern — influence through mastery, not dominance; demanding roles suit you when you bring craft to them
interpret.ten_god_insights.10.zh: 顾问型格局：靠精通产生影响，而不是靠强势压人；带着手艺去担当要求高的角色，最适合你

interpret.ten_god_insights.12.en: the classic friction pattern — candour collides with hierarchy; choose environments that price honesty as an asset, and document wins before challenging rules
interpret.ten_god_insights.12.zh: 典型的摩擦格局：直率撞上等级；选重视坦诚的环境，先把成绩记录下来，再去挑战规则

interpret.ten_god_insights.14.en: stress becomes study: credentials, mentors and frameworks turn 七殺 pressure into rank — the high-stakes professional pattern
interpret.ten_god_insights.14.zh: 压力变成学习：学历、贵人和框架把七杀的压力变成职级，是高压专业人士的典型格局

interpret.ten_god_insights.16.en: raw output with built-in quality control — creative work that survives editing; protect the learning time that powers it
interpret.ten_god_insights.16.zh: 原始的表达力自带质量把关：创作经得起修改；守住滋养它的学习时间

interpret.ten_god_insights.18.en: the steady-ascent pattern — institutions reward you; rank comes through credentials rather than risk
interpret.ten_god_insights.18.zh: 稳步上升的格局：机构会回报你；职级靠资质和资历积累，而不是靠冒险

interpret.ten_god_insights.20.en: partnerships and 'friends' bleed money faster than rivals do — keep finances separate, put agreements in writing
interpret.ten_god_insights.20.zh: 合伙和“朋友”漏钱比对手还快：钱要分开管，约定写成白纸黑字

interpret.ten_god_insights.22.en: opportunities exceed carrying capacity — strengthen the self (rest, support, focus) before chasing more, or money passes through without staying
interpret.ten_god_insights.22.zh: 机会超过承载力：先把自己养强（休息、扶持、专注），再去追更多，否则钱只是从手里经过，留不住

interpret.ten_god_insights.23.en: structure over percentages: 用神 alignment of the heavy gods, rooting of visible stems, classical pair patterns — thresholds on weighted god shares
interpret.ten_god_insights.23.zh: 重结构，不重百分比：看主要十神与用神是否相合、透出的天干有没有根、经典的成对格局，而不是按十神加权占比设阈值

interpret.four_palaces.01.en: clashed 被沖 ({clash_pair}) — attraction comes easily, but the relationship moves through more change before it settles
interpret.four_palaces.01.zh: 被冲（{clash_pair}）：容易互相吸引，但感情要经历更多变动才会安定

interpret.four_palaces.02.en: in combination 逢合 ({he_pair}) — the palace is pulled by another pillar; family and context shape the marriage
interpret.four_palaces.02.zh: 逢合（{he_pair}）：宫位被另一柱牵动；家庭和环境会左右婚姻

interpret.four_palaces.03.en: under {xing_kind} ({xing_pair}) — quiet friction in the domestic seat; name it early rather than let it accumulate
interpret.four_palaces.03.zh: 受 {xing_kind}（{xing_pair}）：家宅之位有暗暗的摩擦；早点说开，别让它越积越多

interpret.four_palaces.04.en: undisturbed — a stable seat for the marriage
interpret.four_palaces.04.zh: 未受冲扰：是婚姻稳固的位置

interpret.four_palaces.05.en: hosts {join_sp_gods} — the partner's energy reads as {TEN_GOD_MEANING_sp_gods}

interpret.four_palaces.07.en: ; output stars at {out_share}% — the bond with children/students runs through shared creation and teaching
interpret.four_palaces.07.zh: ；食伤星占 {out_share}%：与子女、学生的缘分通过共同创作和教导来体现

interpret.four_palaces.08.en: ; output stars at {out_share}% — the bond builds through deliberate time, not shared projects
interpret.four_palaces.08.zh: ；食伤星占 {out_share}%：这份缘分靠有意安排的相处时间来建立，而不是共同做项目

interpret.four_palaces.09.en: natally OPEN 已開 — the storehouse works from birth; accumulation compounds
interpret.four_palaces.09.zh: 原局已开：财库从出生就能运作，积累会越滚越大

interpret.four_palaces.10.en: present but sealed — it opens in {opener} years (the 財庫 vault years in the timing windows); those are the accumulation windows
interpret.four_palaces.10.zh: 有库但封着：到 {opener}年才打开（时机窗口里的财库年）；这些就是积累的窗口

interpret.four_palaces.11.en: no {w_el}-vault branch ({vb}) in the chart — wealth flows rather than stores; retention needs systems (automatic saving), not windfalls
interpret.four_palaces.11.zh: 命盘里没有 {w_el} 库之支（{vb}）：财是流动的，存不住；要靠机制（比如自动储蓄）留财，而不是靠横财

interpret.four_palaces.12.en: 宮位 four-palace doctrine: year=ancestry/0–15, month=career HQ/16–32, day=self+spouse/33–48, hour=children/49+; 財庫 = wealth-element vault branch, opened by its 六沖 clash
interpret.four_palaces.12.zh: 宫位：四宫之说。年柱=祖上，0～15岁；月柱=事业大本营，16～32岁；日柱=自己与配偶，33～48岁；时柱=子女，49岁起；财库=财星五行的库支，由六冲打开

interpret.interpret_person.01.en: [§2] The Day Master — the stem that represents the person — is {day_master} ({dm_el_element_en}{dm_el}), judged {strength_verdict} (score {strength_score:+.2f}; season state {season}).
interpret.interpret_person.01.zh: [§2] 日主，也就是代表你自己的那个天干，是 {day_master}（{dm_el}），判断为 {strength_verdict}（得分 {strength_score:+.2f}；月令状态 {season}）。

interpret.interpret_person.02.en: A strong chart can carry responsibility, output and wealth — it benefits more from productive outlets (食傷·財·官殺) than from further support.
interpret.interpret_person.02.zh: 身强的命盘能担起责任、产出和财；比起继续扶持，更适合通过食伤、财、官杀这几条出口来发挥。

interpret.interpret_person.03.en: A weak chart thrives on support — resource 印 and peers 比劫 strengthen it, while heavy drain (overwork, over-extension, excessive pressure) taxes it.
interpret.interpret_person.03.zh: 身弱的命盘靠扶持才旺：印和比劫能让它强起来，而大量消耗（过劳、铺得太开、压力过大）会拖累它。

interpret.interpret_person.04.en: Strength is a measure of balance, not ability — it only decides which elements act as this person's medicine.
interpret.interpret_person.04.zh: 强弱衡量的是平衡，不是能力，它只决定哪些五行是这个人的用神。

interpret.interpret_person.05.en: [§1·§5] BaZi treats a chart as a five-element ecosystem that wants balance. This one tilts: strongest {hi_element_en}{hi} ({w_hi}), weakest {lo_element_en}{lo} ({w_lo}). The elements that would correct the tilt are the 用神 — here {join_ys_favourable} — and they become practical levers: {wardrobe_phrase_ys}.
interpret.interpret_person.05.zh: [§1·§5] 八字把命盘看成一个追求平衡的五行生态。这张命盘有所偏：{hi} 最旺（{w_hi}），{lo} 最弱（{w_lo}）。能把偏差扶回来的五行就是用神，这里是 {join_ys_favourable}，它们可以落到实处：{wardrobe_phrase_ys}。

interpret.interpret_person.07.en: [§3–4] BaZi classifies every other character by its relationship to the Day Master into ten archetypes (十神) covering five life domains; where a chart's characters concentrate shows where its energy naturally goes. Here the concentration is:
interpret.interpret_person.07.zh: [§3～4] 八字按每个字与日主的关系，把其余各字分成十神这十种角色，涵盖五大人生领域；命盘里哪些字集中，就说明能量自然流向哪里。这张命盘的集中情况是：

interpret.interpret_person.08.en: a supportive decade for this chart.
interpret.interpret_person.08.zh: 这是对这张命盘有扶持的一步大运。

interpret.interpret_person.09.en: a demanding decade — lean harder on the compensations above.
interpret.interpret_person.09.zh: 这步大运要求高，要更多靠上面说的那些补救。

interpret.interpret_person.10.en: a mixed decade — activate the favourable half.
interpret.interpret_person.10.zh: 这步大运好坏参半，把有利的那一半用起来。

interpret.interpret_person.11.en: [§6] Luck cycle 大運 in {year} (age {age}): pillar {gz} (ages {start_age:.0f}–{end_age:.0f}) carries {se_element_en}{se} ({fav_word_se}) over {be_element_en}{be} ({fav_word_be}) — {mood} Each decade-pillar overlays its two elements on the birth chart, tilting the balance for or against it — this is why the same chart has easier and harder decades.
interpret.interpret_person.11.zh: [§6] {year}年（{age}岁）的大运：{gz} 柱（{start_age:.0f}～{end_age:.0f}岁），天干 {se}（{fav_word_se}）盖在地支 {be}（{fav_word_be}）之上，{mood} 每步大运都会把它的两个五行叠在原局上，让平衡朝有利或不利的方向倾斜，这就是同一张命盘既有顺的十年、也有难的十年的原因。

interpret.interpret_person.12.en: [§6] In {year} (age {age}) the first 10-year luck pillar has not started yet — the birth chart itself dominates.
interpret.interpret_person.12.zh: [§6] {year}年（{age}岁）第一步大运还没开始，主要看原局本身。

interpret.interpret_person.13.en: [§8] Life-domain signals (rule-derived, 0–100; compared by standing among charts): strongest {best_en} {best_zh} ({best_score} — {best_band}); most in need of support {low_en} {low_zh} ({low_score}). Each score is assembled from auditable parts — star shares, 神煞 and palace checks, listed under the cards below — and reads as a structural tendency, not a prediction.
interpret.interpret_person.13.zh: [§8] 人生领域信号（按规则得出，0～100；按在命盘中的位次比较）：最强的是 {best_zh}（{best_score}，{best_band}）；最需要扶持的是 {low_zh}（{low_score}）。每个分数都由可核查的部分拼成：星的占比、神煞和宫位检查，列在下面的卡片里；它反映的是结构上的倾向，不是预测。

interpret.interpret_person.14.en: [§7] Directions (八宅): {gua}命 · {gua_group_gua} — best directions {good_dirs_gua}. Sleep with the headboard toward, or face while working/studying, one of these where the room allows. The belief: the hours spent aligned to supportive directions (a third of life is spent asleep) let the home reinforce the chart instead of fighting it.
interpret.interpret_person.14.zh: [§7] 八宅方位：{gua}命 · {gua_group_gua}，吉方有 {good_dirs_gua}。房间条件允许的话，睡觉时头朝这些方向之一，或者工作、学习时面朝其中一个。背后的想法是：长时间（人生有三分之一在睡觉）对准有利的方向，家就能顺着命盘帮你，而不是跟它对着干。

interpret.interpret_person.15.en: [§4] Read the distribution as where life's attention goes by default: this chart runs on {g1} ({p1}% — {g1_ten_god_meaning}) backed by {g2} ({p2}%). That is the engine; point it at things worth doing.
interpret.interpret_person.15.zh: [§4] 把这个分布看作你的注意力默认流向哪里：这张命盘主要靠 {g1}（{p1}%，{g1_ten_god_meaning}）运转，{g2}（{p2}%）为辅。这是你的引擎，把它用在值得做的事上。

interpret.interpret_person.16.en: The faint gods ({join_faint}) mark domains that never happen by themselves here — they need a system, a schedule or a partner who carries them.
interpret.interpret_person.16.zh: 微弱的十神（{join_faint}）对应的领域在这里不会自己发生，需要靠机制、日程，或者一位伙伴来分担。

interpret.interpret_person.17.en: No god is faint — an unusually even spread; versatile, but watch for energy scattering across too many fronts.
interpret.interpret_person.17.zh: 没有哪个十神微弱，分布异常均匀；多面手，但要当心精力分散到太多方面。

interpret.interpret_person.18.en: [§5] Why {join_ys_favourable} are the medicine: 扶抑法 feeds a weak chart and drains a strong one
interpret.interpret_person.18.zh: [§5] 为什么 {join_ys_favourable} 是用神：扶抑法对弱盘是滋养，对强盘是泄耗

interpret.interpret_person.19.en: — this chart is strong, so its medicine is productive outlets (output, wealth, discipline), not more support.
interpret.interpret_person.19.zh: 。这张命盘身强，用神就是发挥的出路（食伤、财、官杀），不是更多扶持。

interpret.interpret_person.20.en: — this chart is weak, so its medicine feeds and protects it (resource and peer elements), not more drain.
interpret.interpret_person.20.zh: 。这张命盘身弱，用神就是滋养和保护它的五行（印和比劫），不是更多消耗。

interpret.interpret_person.21.en: Apply it where exposure is long: bedroom direction, industry, daily colours. Treat 忌神 {join_ys_unfavourable} as load, not poison — fine in doses, taxing as a lifestyle.
interpret.interpret_person.21.zh: 用在长期接触的地方：卧室朝向、行业、日常颜色。把忌神 {join_ys_unfavourable} 当作负担而不是毒药：少量无妨，长期当生活方式就会拖累。

interpret.interpret_person.22.en: 貴人 nobleman stars — help tends to arrive through people; ask early, it is structurally available
interpret.interpret_person.22.zh: 贵人星：帮助多半通过人而来，早点开口，命盘里本来就有这份助力

interpret.interpret_person.23.en: 桃花 — natural charm/visibility; an asset in front-of-people roles, worth boundaries in commitments
interpret.interpret_person.23.zh: 桃花：天生有魅力、容易被看见；适合要面对人的角色，感情承诺里要守好边界

interpret.interpret_person.24.en: 文昌/學堂 — study and writing are supported; exams and credentials pay off above average
interpret.interpret_person.24.zh: 文昌/学堂：学习和写作有助力；考试和学历的回报高于平均

interpret.interpret_person.25.en: 驛馬 — movement luck; relocation, travel and role changes tend to open doors rather than close them
interpret.interpret_person.25.zh: 驿马：走动运；搬家、出行和换岗位多半是开门而不是关门

interpret.interpret_person.26.en: 華蓋 — a solitary, contemplative streak; depth over breadth, needs alone-time to recharge
interpret.interpret_person.26.zh: 华盖：有独处、爱沉思的一面；重深不重广，要有独处时间来恢复精力

interpret.interpret_person.27.zh: [§9] 命盘里有 {len_ss} 个神煞，给它添了些色彩。

interpret.interpret_person.29.en: None of the major auspicious clusters — read the individual notes below.
interpret.interpret_person.29.zh: 没有出现主要的吉星组合，请看下面各项单独的说明。

interpret.interpret_person.30.en: 神煞 are flavour on top of structure — never let one star overrule the balance reading above.
interpret.interpret_person.30.zh: 神煞只是结构之上的点缀，千万别让某一颗星压过上面的平衡解读。

interpret.interpret_person.31.en: [§10] Temperament, read straight off the ten-god mix:
interpret.interpret_person.31.zh: [§10] 性格，直接从十神的配比读出：

interpret.interpret_person.32.en: . These are operating instructions, not judgments — arrange work and relationships so the tendencies are features.
interpret.interpret_person.32.zh: 。这些是使用说明，不是评判，安排工作和关系时让这些倾向成为优点。

interpret.interpret_person.33.en: no axis shows a strong tendency — a flexible, situation-driven temperament. The cost of flexibility is drift; external structure (deadlines, partners, routines) substitutes for the missing internal compulsion.
interpret.interpret_person.33.zh: 没有哪条轴倾向明显，性格灵活、随情境而变。灵活的代价是容易没有重心；用外部的框架（截止日期、伙伴、日常规律）补上缺少的内在驱动力。

interpret.interpret_person.34.en: {h_element} — {h_organs} carry the first strain when life overloads
interpret.interpret_person.34.zh: {h_element}：生活超负荷时，{h_organs} 最先吃力

interpret.interpret_person.35.en: {h_element} — {h_organs} deserve baseline care before symptoms ask for it
interpret.interpret_person.35.zh: {h_element}：{h_organs} 值得在出症状之前先做基础保养

interpret.interpret_person.36.en: [§11] Where this chart's body keeps score:
interpret.interpret_person.36.zh: [§11] 这张命盘的身体最容易在哪里留下痕迹：

interpret.interpret_person.37.en: . Balanced elements are not risk markers. Reference against the timing trigger years, not medical advice.
interpret.interpret_person.37.zh: 。平衡的五行不算风险标记。请对照时机窗口里的触发年份来看，这不是医疗建议。

interpret.interpret_person.38.en: [§11] All five elements sit in the balanced band — no organ system is structurally flagged. Maintenance beats intervention: seasonal food, regular sleep, and use the the timing-window recovery years for elective procedures.
interpret.interpret_person.38.zh: [§11] 五行都在平衡区间，没有哪个脏腑系统在结构上被标出。维护胜过干预：吃应季的食物、规律睡觉，择期的治疗或手术可以放在时机窗口里的恢复年。

interpret.interpret_person.39.en: [§12] Careers are ranked by how cheaply this chart converts effort into result: {t1_en} {t1_zh} and {t2_en} {t2_zh} lead because their field elements feed the 用神 and their working style matches the dominant gods.
interpret.interpret_person.39.zh: [§12] 职业按这张命盘把努力换成结果的成本从低到高排序：{t1_zh} 和 {t2_zh} 排在前面，因为它们的五行能滋养用神，工作方式也与主导十神相合。

interpret.interpret_person.40.en: {av_en} is priced against the chart — possible, but it spends more than it returns; choose it only for reasons the chart doesn't measure.
interpret.interpret_person.40.zh: {av_en} 与这张命盘不太相配：做得到，但付出多过回报；选它，只该是出于命盘衡量不到的理由。

interpret.interpret_person.41.zh: 势头有结构支撑，可以扩张

interpret.interpret_person.42.en: friction does the teaching — repair, consolidate, don't force expansion
interpret.interpret_person.42.zh: 摩擦在教你：修复、巩固，不要硬扩张

interpret.interpret_person.43.en: the ground is shifting — stay liquid and commit late
interpret.interpret_person.43.zh: 地面在动：保持流动性，晚点再下决心

interpret.interpret_person.44.en: gains want banking, not betting — build quietly
interpret.interpret_person.44.zh: 进账要存起来，不要拿去赌：悄悄积累

interpret.interpret_person.45.zh: 当前这步大运（{cur_d_gz}，{cur_d_ages}岁）属于 {cur_d_phase_zh} 阶段：{PHASE_GLOSS_cur_d_phase}。

interpret.interpret_person.47.en: Outside the tabulated 大運 decades (before the first or past the last) the birth chart itself dominates — the year-by-year table below still applies.
interpret.interpret_person.47.zh: 表上没有列出的大运之外（第一步之前或最后一步之后），主要看原局本身，下面逐年的表仍然适用。

interpret.interpret_person.48.en: Standout years ahead: {join_peaks} — schedule launches and commitments into them.
interpret.interpret_person.48.zh: 往后的旺年：{join_peaks}，把启动和承诺排进这些年。

interpret.interpret_person.49.en: No peak year in the next ten — a building stretch; judge yourself on inputs, not outcomes.
interpret.interpret_person.49.zh: 未来十年没有旺年，是积累期；以投入而不是结果来衡量自己。

interpret.interpret_person.50.en: Care flagged in {join_cares}: consolidation years, not retreat years.
interpret.interpret_person.50.zh: 需要留意的年份：{join_cares}，这是巩固之年，不是退缩之年。

liunian.annual_afflictions.01.en: 太歲 可坐不可向 — sitting with your back to it is fine; avoid FACING it for long periods, and never renovate or dig in its sector this year
liunian.annual_afflictions.01.zh: 太岁可坐不可向：背对它没问题；避免长时间面朝它，今年也不要在它的方位动土装修

liunian.annual_afflictions.02.en: 歲破 (opposite 太歲) — the year breaker; avoid ground-breaking and major disturbance in this sector
liunian.annual_afflictions.02.zh: 岁破（与太岁正对）：年内最易受冲破的方位；这个方位避免动土和大的扰动

liunian.annual_afflictions.03.en: 三煞 可向不可坐 — facing it is acceptable; avoid SITTING toward it and avoid renovation in its sectors
liunian.annual_afflictions.03.zh: 三煞可向不可坐：面朝它可以；避免背对它而坐，其所在方位也避免装修

remedies.wardrobe_phrase.01.zh: 穿戴和布置用 {join_ys_colours} 这些颜色，房间里也多用这些五行的方位；{join_ys_unfavourable} 在装饰和衣着上低调些

shensha.TEN_GOD_MEANING.比肩.en: peers & self-reliance — siblings, equals, standing your ground
shensha.TEN_GOD_MEANING.比肩.zh: 同辈与自立：兄弟姐妹、同辈、站稳自己的立场

shensha.TEN_GOD_MEANING.劫財.en: rivals & boldness — shared resources, competition, risk appetite
shensha.TEN_GOD_MEANING.劫財.zh: 对手与敢闯：共享资源、竞争、风险偏好

shensha.TEN_GOD_MEANING.食神.en: gentle output — enjoyment, nurture, easy creativity
shensha.TEN_GOD_MEANING.食神.zh: 温和的表达：享受、滋养、轻松的创造力

shensha.TEN_GOD_MEANING.傷官.en: sharp output — brilliance, critique, rebellion against rules
shensha.TEN_GOD_MEANING.傷官.zh: 犀利的表达：才华横溢、批评、对规则的反叛

shensha.TEN_GOD_MEANING.偏財.en: windfall wealth — opportunity, generosity, business flair
shensha.TEN_GOD_MEANING.偏財.zh: 意外之财：机会、慷慨、做生意的天分

shensha.TEN_GOD_MEANING.正財.en: steady wealth — salary, prudence, savings (spouse star in a man's chart)
shensha.TEN_GOD_MEANING.正財.zh: 稳定的财富：薪水、谨慎、储蓄（男命的配偶星）

shensha.TEN_GOD_MEANING.七殺.en: raw pressure — ambition, decisiveness, discipline imposed from outside
shensha.TEN_GOD_MEANING.七殺.zh: 强烈的压力：进取心、果断、来自外部的纪律

shensha.TEN_GOD_MEANING.正官.en: proper authority — rules, status, responsibility (spouse star in a woman's chart)
shensha.TEN_GOD_MEANING.正官.zh: 正当的权威：规则、地位、责任（女命的配偶星）

shensha.TEN_GOD_MEANING.偏印.en: unconventional learning — intuition, niche skills, solitary study
shensha.TEN_GOD_MEANING.偏印.zh: 不拘一格的学习：直觉、小众技能、独自钻研

shensha.TEN_GOD_MEANING.正印.en: nurturing support — study, protection, elders, credentials
shensha.TEN_GOD_MEANING.正印.zh: 滋养与扶持：学习、庇护、长辈、学历

shensha.MEANING.天乙貴人.en: Nobleman — helpful people appear at critical moments
shensha.MEANING.天乙貴人.zh: 天乙贵人：关键时刻有人出手相助

shensha.MEANING.太極貴人.en: Tai Ji noble — affinity for philosophy, metaphysics, deep research
shensha.MEANING.太極貴人.zh: 太极贵人：对哲学、玄学、深入研究有亲和力

shensha.MEANING.文昌貴人.zh: 文昌贵人：学习、写作、考试

shensha.MEANING.學堂.en: Study Hall — natural learner, academic aptitude
shensha.MEANING.學堂.zh: 学堂：天生爱学习，有学术天赋

shensha.MEANING.桃花.en: Peach Blossom — charm, attraction, social magnetism
shensha.MEANING.桃花.zh: 桃花：魅力、吸引力、社交感染力

shensha.MEANING.驛馬.en: Travel Horse — movement, relocation, overseas links
shensha.MEANING.驛馬.zh: 驿马：奔波、搬迁、海外缘分

shensha.MEANING.華蓋.en: Canopy — solitary depth, spirituality, arts; thrives on niche study
shensha.MEANING.華蓋.zh: 华盖：独处的深度、灵性、艺术；适合钻研小众学问

shensha.MEANING.空亡.en: Void — the tagged pillar's matters feel intangible until triggered
shensha.MEANING.空亡.zh: 空亡：所在柱的事感觉虚而不实，直到被触发

shensha.MEANING.羊刃.en: Yang Blade — drive and decisiveness; watch impulsiveness
shensha.MEANING.羊刃.zh: 羊刃：冲劲与决断；留意冲动

shensha.MEANING.天德貴人.en: Heavenly Virtue — protective benevolence, eases crises
shensha.MEANING.天德貴人.zh: 天德贵人：庇佑的善意，能化解危机

shensha.MEANING.月德貴人.en: Monthly Virtue — quiet protection and goodwill
shensha.MEANING.月德貴人.zh: 月德贵人：默默的保护与善意

shensha.MEANING.將星.zh: 将星：领导力、统率的气场

shensha.MEANING.劫煞.en: Robbery Sha — guard resources, avoid overexposure to risk
shensha.MEANING.劫煞.zh: 劫煞：守住资源，避免过度暴露于风险

shensha.MEANING.祿神.en: Salary star — innate earning capacity; steady income where it sits
shensha.MEANING.祿神.zh: 禄神：天生的赚钱能力；禄所在之处收入稳定

shensha.life_palaces.01.zh: 命宫/胎元（渊海子平宫位公式）· 年命星 紫白数根法（紫白九星），自立春年起算

synthesis._SHADOW.比劫.en: keep money and friendships in separate ledgers

synthesis._SHADOW.官殺.zh: 每次冲刺之后，都留出恢复的预算

synthesis._SHADOW.食傷.en: finish one thing before opening the next
synthesis._SHADOW.食傷.zh: 先做完一件事，再开下一件

synthesis._SHADOW.印.en: act before you feel fully prepared
synthesis._SHADOW.印.zh: 不必等到觉得准备充分，先行动

synthesis.geju_line.01.en: no 月支藏干 is 透 — the chart frames on the 司令 {ruler_god} with the transparent stems as actors
synthesis.geju_line.01.zh: 月支藏干没有一个透出，命盘就以司令的 {ruler_god} 为框架，以透出的天干为主角

synthesis.geju_line.02.en: 格局: 月令 {mb}, 本氣 {ruler} ({ruler_god}) 司令 · {frame}. The 格 names the chart's operating frame; the strength verdict below says how well the frame is carried.
synthesis.geju_line.02.zh: 格局：月令 {mb}，本气 {ruler}（{ruler_god}）司令 · {frame}。格指明这张命盘运作的框架；下面的强弱判断说明这个框架撑得有多好。

synthesis.medicine_ranking.04.en: Within 土, wet earth 濕土 (辰丑) genuinely generates 金; dry earth 燥土 (未戌) is neutral-to-unhelpful — and the ceiling is 土多金埋: past sufficiency, more earth buries the metal it was meant to feed.
synthesis.medicine_ranking.04.zh: 在土之中，湿土（辰丑）真正能生金；燥土（未戌）不生金，甚至帮不上忙。而且有个上限，叫土多金埋：土过了够用的程度，再多就把它本该滋养的金埋住了。

synthesis.synthesis.01.en: This is a {dm} {dm_el_element_en} chart judged {strength_verdict} (score {strength_score}), with its weight in {heavy} ({heavy_2}%)
synthesis.synthesis.01.zh: 这是一张 {dm}{dm_el_element_en} 命盘，判断为 {strength_verdict}（得分 {strength_score}），力量集中在 {heavy}（{heavy_2}%）

synthesis.synthesis.02.en: — the classical {x_x} shape: more to hold than the hands are yet strong enough to carry.
synthesis.synthesis.02.zh: ，这是经典的 {x_x} 格局：要扛的东西多，手上的力气却还不够。

synthesis.synthesis.03.en: Its working friction is 貪財壞印: the {wealth_el_element_en} wealth camp ({wealth}%) directly controls the {res_el_element_en} resource camp ({res}%) that feeds the Day Master — chasing outcomes starves the support system that makes outcomes durable.
synthesis.synthesis.03.zh: 它主要的摩擦在于贪财坏印：{wealth_el_element_en} 财星一方（{wealth}%）直接克制着滋养日主的 {res_el_element_en} 印星一方（{res}%）；一味追结果，就会饿坏让结果能够持久的扶持。

synthesis.synthesis.04.en: The protective 印 is present but 藏而不透 (hidden in branches, no rooted visible stem): support does not arrive automatically — it works when deliberately invoked (study, mentors, credentials).
synthesis.synthesis.04.zh: 起保护作用的印虽然有，却是藏而不透（藏在地支里，没有通根的可见天干）：扶持不会自动到来，要主动去用才有效（学习、贵人、证书）。

synthesis.synthesis.05.en: With 比劫 entirely absent, self-force must be built, not assumed: structures and allies substitute for raw stamina.
synthesis.synthesis.05.zh: 比劫完全缺失，自身的力量要靠打造，不能想当然：用框架和同伴来补足原始的体力。

synthesis.synthesis.06.en: The present {cur_gz} decade is {cur_phase_zh} ({cur_phase}); the chart's structural season arrives with {first_growth_gz} at ages {first_growth_ages} — a late-building arc, so the early decades are for containers, not conquest.
synthesis.synthesis.06.zh: 当前的 {cur_gz} 大运是 {cur_phase_zh}（{cur_phase}）；命盘真正得力的时期，要到 {first_growth_gz} 大运才来，在 {first_growth_ages}岁。这是个晚成的走势，所以早年的几步大运宜先搭好容器，不宜急着扩张。

synthesis.synthesis.07.en: The present {cur_gz} decade is {cur_phase_zh} — the chart is already in its supported season.
synthesis.synthesis.07.zh: 当前的 {cur_gz} 大运是 {cur_phase_zh}，命盘已经走进有扶持的阶段。

synthesis.synthesis.08.en: The medicine is {fav}: choose environments, colours, fields and sectors that carry it, and treat the abundant elements as weather to dress for, not fuel to add.
synthesis.synthesis.08.zh: 用神是 {fav}：选择带有它的环境、颜色、行业和方位；对偏多的五行，当作要添衣防备的天气，不要当燃料去添。

synthesis.synthesis.09.en: Confidence note: the verdict above is the 扶抑 method's; the 窮通寶鑑 調候 prescription for this month is {gods}, which {v} with it
synthesis.synthesis.09.zh: 信心说明：以上判断依据扶抑法；这个月的《穷通宝鉴》调候用神是 {gods}，与之{v}

synthesis.synthesis.10.en: — satisfy the climate stems through use and the 扶抑 elements through support; both, not either.
synthesis.synthesis.10.zh: 。调候的天干要靠运用来满足，扶抑的五行要靠扶持来满足；两者兼顾，不是二选一。

synthesis.synthesis.11.en: Confidence note: the verdict is the 扶抑 (support-the-weak) method's; the 調候 climate school weighs the birth season separately and can lean differently — where the two disagree, satisfying both is the safe posture.
synthesis.synthesis.11.zh: 信心说明：以上判断依据扶抑法（扶弱抑强）；调候派单独权衡出生的季节，结论可能不同。两者不一致时，两边都顾到最稳妥。

synthesis.spouse_reading.08.en: A prominent spouse star marks the theme as central; its condition, not its size, decides the quality.
synthesis.spouse_reading.08.zh: 配偶星突出，说明这个主题是核心；决定质量的是它的状态，不是它的大小。

synthesis.spouse_reading.09.en: A quiet spouse star means the relationship follows the palace and the years more than the natal weight.
synthesis.spouse_reading.09.zh: 配偶星不显，说明感情更多跟着配偶宫和流年走，而不是原局的分量。

synthesis.spouse_reading.10.en: Spouse palace (day branch {sp_branch}): {sp_line} The palace is {sp_state}.
synthesis.spouse_reading.10.zh: 配偶宫（日支 {sp_branch}）：{sp_line} 这个宫位 {sp_state}。

synthesis.spouse_reading.11.en: 傷官見官 in a woman's chart reads on the MARRIAGE axis before the career one: the talent that critiques authority also critiques the partner. Managed openly (channel the critique into shared projects), it is compatibility with texture, not an affliction.
synthesis.spouse_reading.11.zh: 女命见伤官见官，先看婚姻这条线，再看事业：会批评权威的才华，也会批评伴侣。若能坦率处理（把批评用到共同的事上），这是一种带点棱角的合拍，而不是缺陷。

synthesis.spouse_reading.12.en: Watch-window: the {gz} decade (ages {int_start_age}–{int_end_age}) introduces {missing} beside the natal {x_x} — 官殺混雜 by luck: two models of authority/partnership run at once in that window; clarity about which applies matters more than usual.
synthesis.spouse_reading.12.zh: 留意期：{gz} 大运（{int_start_age}～{int_end_age}岁）在原局的 {x_x} 之外，又带来 {missing}，成了运里的官杀混杂：这段时间里，两种权威或伴侣的模式同时运行，弄清楚哪一种适用，比平时更重要。

synthesis.spouse_reading.13.en: spouse star (十神) × spouse palace (日支) × activation years (流年) — the three-legged classical marriage reading
synthesis.spouse_reading.13.zh: 配偶星（十神）× 配偶宫（日支）× 触发之年（流年），这就是经典婚姻解读的三条腿

synthesis.clinical_report.15.zh: 日主偏弱，靠印星和自身五行来滋养

synthesis.clinical_report.16.en: a strong day master spends through output, wealth and pressure
synthesis.clinical_report.16.zh: 日主偏强，要通过食伤、财星和官杀把力量用出去

synthesis.clinical_report.20.zh: 它们会泄掉命盘所缺的

synthesis.clinical_report.21.zh: 它们会加重本来就偏重的

synthesis.clinical_report.23.en: {bad_god} at {bad_pct}% carries {bad_el} {en_bad_el}, a 忌 element: it delivers, but on borrowed energy.
synthesis.clinical_report.23.zh: {bad_god} 占 {bad_pct}%，带着 {bad_el}，是忌的五行：它能出成果，靠的却是借来的能量。

synthesis.clinical_report.24.en: The heavy gods all carry favourable elements: engine and medicine point the same way.
synthesis.clinical_report.24.zh: 重的十神带的都是喜用五行：动力和用神指向同一个方向。

synthesis.clinical_report.25.zh: {len_ins_rooted} 个可见天干中，有 {len_rooted} 个通根。

synthesis.clinical_report.34.en: absent — wealth flows rather than stores.

synthesis.clinical_report.37.en: No symbolic star is carried — the structure reads unadorned.
synthesis.clinical_report.37.zh: 命盘里没有神煞，结构一目了然。

synthesis.clinical_report.42.zh: 下一个要谨慎的年份：{cau_y}年 {cau_gz}（{join_flags_cau}）。

synthesis.clinical_report.45.en: {p_group} ({p_gua}): face {x} (生氣) for bed and desk; keep {x_2} (絕命) for storage. Colours {join_ys_colours} carry the medicine.
synthesis.clinical_report.45.zh: {p_group}（{p_gua}）：床头和书桌朝 {x}（生气），{x_2}（绝命）留给储物。颜色选 {join_ys_colours}，它们带着你的用神。

synthesis.clinical_report.46.en: The chart's defining tension is that its engine is also its drain: {bad_god} carries {bad_el} {en_bad_el}, which a {weak_strong} {en_dm_el} day master cannot afford to run on unchecked.
synthesis.clinical_report.46.zh: 这张命盘的核心矛盾是：它的动力同时也是它的消耗。{bad_god} 带着 {bad_el}，而 {en_dm_el}日主 {weak_strong}，经不起毫无制衡地靠它运转。

synthesis.clinical_report.49.en: The defining tension is {bad_god} ({bad_pct}%) on {bad_el} {en_bad_el}: it supplies {_GRP_EN_grp_of_bad_god} the chart uses, at the cost of the recovery a {weak_strong} day master {needs_can_spar}.
synthesis.clinical_report.49.zh: 核心矛盾是 {bad_el} 上的 {bad_god}（{bad_pct}%）：它供给命盘要用的 {_GRP_EN_grp_of_bad_god}，代价是日主 {weak_strong}时 {needs_can_spar} 的那份恢复。

synthesis.clinical_report.54.en: The chart's heavy gods and its medicine point the same way: what drives this person also feeds them.
synthesis.clinical_report.54.zh: 这张命盘的重神和用神方向一致：推动这个人的，也在滋养这个人。

synthesis.clinical_report.55.en: Support outweighs drain ({parts_support} to {parts_drain}) yet the {mb} month sets the verdict: well-backed but under-lit — it needs warmth more than help.
synthesis.clinical_report.55.zh: 扶持大于泄耗（{parts_support} 比 {parts_drain}），但 {mb}月定下了判断：靠得住却照不到光，它要的是暖意，不是帮手。

synthesis.clinical_report.56.en: Drain exceeds support ({parts_drain} to {parts_support}): the chart is genuinely thin and every favourable element added is felt.
synthesis.clinical_report.56.zh: 泄耗大于扶持（{parts_drain} 比 {parts_support}）：这张命盘确实单薄，每多补一个喜用五行，都感觉得到。

synthesis.clinical_report.57.en: Support exceeds drain ({parts_support} to {parts_drain}): the chart has surplus to spend, and spending it is the medicine.
synthesis.clinical_report.57.zh: 扶持大于泄耗（{parts_support} 比 {parts_drain}）：命盘有余力可用，把余力用出去，就是用神。

synthesis.clinical_report.59.zh: 时机适合现在就动手打基础。

synthesis.clinical_report.60.en: hold structure and pace effort until the next growth decade.
synthesis.clinical_report.60.zh: 守住结构，放慢用力的节奏，等下一步成长大运。

synthesis.clinical_report.62.en: Supply {fav} {en_fav} first: {join_ys_colours} in the rooms you spend hours in{ind}.

synthesis.clinical_report.63.en: Set bed head and desk to face {best}; keep long sitting out of {x}.
synthesis.clinical_report.63.zh: 床头和书桌朝 {best}；久坐要避开 {x}。

synthesis.clinical_report.67.en: Support {low_zh} {low_en} ({low_score}), the domain that stands lowest among charts, with routine rather than effort spikes.
synthesis.clinical_report.67.zh: 用规律的日常，而不是用力冲刺，来扶持在命盘中位次最低的领域：{low_zh}（{low_score}分）。

synthesis.clinical_report.69.en: Method: the verdict is 扶抑's; the 窮通寶鑑 調候 prescription for the {mb} month ({join_x}) {th_verdict}
synthesis.clinical_report.69.zh: 方法：判断依据扶抑法；{mb}月《穷通宝鉴》的调候用神（{join_x}）与之{th_verdict}

synthesis.clinical_report.70.en: — satisfy both: climate stems through use, 扶抑 elements through support.
synthesis.clinical_report.70.zh: ，两边都要满足：调候的天干靠运用，扶抑的五行靠扶持。

synthesis.clinical_report.71.en: Method note: the verdict is the 扶抑 method's; the 調候 climate school can lean differently — where they disagree, satisfying both is the safe posture.
synthesis.clinical_report.71.zh: 方法说明：判断依据扶抑法；调候派的结论可能不同，两者不一致时，两边都顾到最稳妥。

yongshen.yong_shen.14.zh: 没有发现先天的偏弊：伤官见官、比劫夺财、财多身弱都没有达到通常的判定线，所以病药不再补充什么，只按扶抑来看

yongshen.yong_shen.15.en: 傷官見官: sharp expression meets rules and authority, which 《淵海子平》〈論傷官〉 calls 為禍百端. The medicine is 印 ({el}): 〈傷官說〉 says 傷官見官，印運不妨.
yongshen.yong_shen.15.zh: 伤官见官：锋利的表达遇上规矩和权威，《渊海子平》〈论伤官〉称之为“为祸百端”。药是印（{el}）：〈伤官说〉说“伤官见官，印运不妨”。

yongshen.yong_shen.16.en: 比劫奪財: peers and rivals take the wealth the chart earns (《淵海子平》〈論劫財〉). The medicine is 官殺 ({el}), the check on 比劫 (〈論陽刃〉 喜偏官七殺).
yongshen.yong_shen.16.zh: 比劫夺财：同辈和对手会分走命盘赚到的财（《渊海子平》〈论劫财〉）。药是官杀（{el}），它是对比劫的制约（〈论阳刃〉“喜偏官七杀”）。

yongshen.yong_shen.17.en: 財多身弱: more wealth than the Day Master can carry, so it does not stay (《三命通會》卷六〈論正財〉: 財多身弱，柱無印助，皆不為福). The medicine is 印 ({el}): 身衰逢印資助.
yongshen.yong_shen.17.zh: 财多身弱：财多过日主能承载的量，所以留不住（《三命通会》卷六〈论正财〉：“财多身弱，柱无印助，皆不为福”）。药是印（{el}）：“身衰逢印资助”。

yongshen.yong_shen.18.en: Your 扶抑 reading also favours {el}, so the two readings agree.
yongshen.yong_shen.18.zh: 你的扶抑判断同样偏好{el}，两种判断一致。

yongshen.yong_shen.19.en: Your 扶抑 reading avoids {el}, so 扶抑 leads and this medicine is a short-term aid, not a lasting choice.
yongshen.yong_shen.19.zh: 你的扶抑判断要避开{el}，所以以扶抑为准，这味药只是短期的辅助，不是长久之计。

yongshen.yong_shen.20.en: Your 扶抑 reading neither favours nor avoids {el}, so treat this medicine as secondary: 扶抑 leads.
yongshen.yong_shen.20.zh: 你的扶抑判断对{el}既不偏好也不回避，所以这味药只作次要参考，以扶抑为准。

yongshen.yong_shen.21.en: not used on a single chart: 通關 is applied only between two charts, in the pair report
yongshen.yong_shen.21.zh: 单张命盘不用这一法：通关只用在两张命盘之间，也就是合婚报告里

story._balance.22.en: Your chart has one built-in strain: sharp expression meets rules and responsibility, so candour can cost you standing; the classical remedy is mentors and learning
story._balance.22.zh: 你的命盘有一处先天的偏弊：表达太锋利，撞上规矩和责任，直言容易折损你的口碑；古法的对治是贵人和学习

story._balance.23.en: Your chart has one built-in strain: peers and rivals draw off what you earn, so money tends to leak to people close to you; the classical remedy is rules and responsibility
story._balance.23.zh: 你的命盘有一处先天的偏弊：同辈和对手会分走你赚到的钱，钱容易流向身边的人；古法的对治是规矩和责任

story._balance.24.en: Your chart has one built-in strain: more opportunity than you can carry, so money passes through without staying; the classical remedy is mentors and learning
story._balance.24.zh: 你的命盘有一处先天的偏弊：机会多过你扛得住的量，钱只是路过、留不下；古法的对治是贵人和学习

story._balance.25.en: , which your balance reading also favours.
story._balance.25.zh: ，你的平衡判断也认同这一点。

story._balance.26.en: , but your balance reading points elsewhere, so treat that remedy as a short-term fix.
story._balance.26.zh: ，但你的平衡判断指向别处，所以只把它当作短期的补救。

story._timing.40.en: It is also a punishment year for the {an_}: strain tends to build slowly, so put big commitments in writing.
story._timing.40.zh: 这一年对属{an_}的人也是刑太岁年：压力往往慢慢累积，所以重大承诺要落到纸面上。

story._timing.41.en: It is also a self-punishment year for the {an_}: the strain tends to be self-made, so pace yourself and check things twice.
story._timing.41.zh: 这一年对属{an_}的人也是自刑年：压力多半是自己造成的，所以放慢节奏，事事多核对一遍。

plain.GOD_ROLE.劫财.en: Rivals and bold moves shape this part of life.
plain.GOD_ROLE.劫财.zh: 对手和大胆的行动，影响着人生的这一方面。

plain.GOD_ROLE.伤官.en: Sharp expression and a will to challenge show here.
plain.GOD_ROLE.伤官.zh: 犀利的表达和敢于挑战的意愿，在这里显现。

plain.GOD_ROLE.正财.en: Steady earning and careful management show here.
plain.GOD_ROLE.正财.zh: 稳定的收入和细致的打理，在这里显现。

plain.GOD_ROLE.偏财.en: Deals, windfalls and generosity show here.
plain.GOD_ROLE.偏财.zh: 买卖往来、意外之财和慷慨，在这里显现。

plain.GOD_ROLE.七杀.en: Pressure and hard challenges shape this part of life, and make you decisive.
plain.GOD_ROLE.七杀.zh: 压力和艰难的挑战影响着人生的这一方面，也逼你学会果断。

story.PHASE_BY_VOICE.teen.transition.en: Expect changes at home or school; keep routines steady.
story.PHASE_BY_VOICE.teen.transition.zh: 家里或学校可能有变动；作息尽量保持稳定。

story.STAR_GIST.天乙贵人.en: so helpful people appear at the moments that matter
story.STAR_GIST.天乙贵人.zh: 所以关键时刻总有人出手相助

story.STAR_GIST.太极贵人.en: a pull toward philosophy and deep study
story.STAR_GIST.太极贵人.zh: 容易被哲学和深入的钻研吸引

story.STAR_GIST.华盖.en: a taste for solitude, depth and the arts

story.STAR_GIST.学堂.en: the mark of a natural learner

story.STAR_GIST.禄神.en: the means to a steady income

story.STAR_GIST.月德.zh: 能缓和艰难年份的庇护

story.STAR_GIST.金舆.zh: 得到他人的照应与扶持

story.STAR_GIST.灾煞.en: so take care with accidents and hasty moves
story.STAR_GIST.灾煞.zh: 所以要小心意外和仓促的举动

story.STAR_GIST.寡宿.en: a streak of independence and solitude
story.STAR_GIST.寡宿.zh: 带着一股独立、爱独处的劲头

story._timing.20.en: {when} are a good time to learn and build habits.
story._timing.20.zh: {when} 是学习和养成习惯的好时候。

story._timing.27.en: These are years for steady habits rather than big changes.
story._timing.27.zh: 这几年适合靠稳定的习惯，而不是大动作。

careers.career_roles.01.zh: 行业对应的五行 {e} 属于你的喜用
